Strategy: Reward bins whose residual has no neighbour within 10 units, favouring isolated residual sizes that diversify the open bins, with Best Fit ordering elsewhere.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (20 if sum([1 for x in bins if abs(r - x) <= 10]) <= 1 else 0) for r in bins]
```
